heading.en: Origins, the Northern Expedition and the anti-Chiang campaign

body.zh-Hant: 傅作義是中國的軍人、政治家，生於1893年、卒於1974年，出身山西省，1918年自保定軍官學校畢業。北伐時他支持蔣介石等南方派，在閻錫山麾下與張作霖作戰；1930年他參加反蔣作戰，結果大敗。
body.en: Fu Zuoyi was a Chinese soldier and politician, born in 1893 and died in 1974, from Shanxi Province, and a 1918 graduate of the Baoding Military Academy. During the Northern Expedition he sided with Chiang Kai-shek and the southern camp and fought Zhang Zuolin under Yan Xishan; in 1930 he joined the anti-Chiang campaign and was heavily defeated.

citations.quote: 中国の軍人、政治家。山西省出身。1918年、保定軍官学校卒業。
北伐に際しては蒋介石(しょうかいせき)ら南方派を支持して閻錫山(えんしゃくざん)のもとで張作霖(ちょうさくりん)と戦ったが
1930年、反蒋作戦に参加して大敗した

heading.zh-Hant: 綏遠省主席與抗日作戰
heading.en: Suiyuan chairmanship and the war against Japan

body.zh-Hant: 1931年起，傅作義擔任綏遠省政府主席，在當地一帶建立勢力，1935年當選國民黨中央委員。他反對日本進入內蒙古，1936年在百靈廟戰役中擊敗日軍；抗日戰爭期間，他擔任第十二戰區總司令等職，與日軍對峙。
body.en: From 1931 Fu was chairman of the Suiyuan provincial government and built up his power in the area; in 1935 he was elected a Kuomintang Central Committee member. Opposing Japanese advances into Inner Mongolia, he defeated Japanese forces in the 1936 battle at Bailingmiao, and during the war of resistance he served as commander-in-chief of the 12th War Zone and confronted the Japanese army.

citations.quote: 翌1931年からは綏遠(すいえん)省政府主席としてこの一帯に勢力を張り、1935年、国民党中央委員に選出された
日本の内モンゴル進出に反対して、1936年、百霊廟(ひゃくれいびょう)で日本軍を撃破
抗日戦争中は第一二戦区総司令などの任にあって日本軍と対峙(たいじ)した

heading.en: Postwar career and the peaceful liberation of Beijing

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰結束後的1947年，他出任察哈爾省主席、華北掃共司令等職，與人民解放軍對立；1949年1月，他協助北京的和平解放。同年10月中華人民共和國成立，他當選中央人民政府委員、軍事委員會委員，擔任政務院水利部長，後任水利電力部長；1965年任人民政治協商會議全國委員會副主席。
body.en: In 1947, after the war, he was appointed chairman of Chahar Province and commander for suppressing the Communists in North China, opposing the People's Liberation Army; in January 1949 he cooperated in the peaceful liberation of Beijing. With the founding of the People's Republic in October he was elected to the Central People's Government Council and the Military Commission, served as Minister of Water Conservancy and later Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, and in 1965 became a vice-chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

citations.quote: 抗戦後の1947年、察哈爾(チャハル)省主席、華北掃共司令などに任じて人民解放軍と対立した

heading.en: Origins and early affiliations

body.zh-Hant: 馮玉祥是中國軍閥政治家，生於1882年、卒於1948年，安徽省出身，被稱為基督徒將軍。他起初追隨段祺瑞，後來接近直隸派。世界大百科事典則說他字煥章，是安徽省巢縣人，出身貧農之家，苦學力行而一度掌握最高權力。
body.en: Feng Yuxiang was a Chinese warlord-politician, born in 1882 and died in 1948, from Anhui Province, and was known as the Christian General. He first followed Duan Qirui and later drew close to the Zhili clique. The Sekai Daihyakka Jiten adds that his courtesy name was Huanzhang, that he came from Chao County in Anhui, was born to a poor peasant family, and rose through hard study and effort to hold supreme power for a time.

citations.quote: 中国の軍閥政治家。「ひょうぎょくしょう」とも読まれる。安徽(あんき)省出身。
民主化の方向を志向し、クリスチャン将軍とよばれた
初めは段祺瑞(だんきずい)（安徽派）に従い、のち直隷(ちょくれい)派に接近
字は煥章。安徽省巣県の人。貧農の家に生まれたが，苦学力行してついには一時最高権力を手中にした。

heading.en: The 1924 Beijing coup

body.zh-Hant: 1924年10月，馮玉祥在北京突然發動兵變，自稱國民軍並驅逐直隸派的曹錕，一時掌握北方實權。世界大百科事典記載，他在第二次奉直戰爭後成為國民軍總司令並控制北京，還把清朝廢帝逐出紫禁城。
body.en: In October 1924 Feng suddenly staged a mutiny in Beijing, styled his force the National Army and drove out Cao Kun of the Zhili clique, briefly holding real power in the north. The Sekai Daihyakka Jiten records that after the Second Zhili–Fengtian War he became commander-in-chief of the National Army, took control of Beijing, and expelled the deposed Qing emperor from the Forbidden City.

citations.quote: 1924年10月、北京(ペキン)で突如兵変を起こし、自ら国民軍と称して直隷派の曹錕(そうこん)を追い
一時、北方の実権を握った
1924年の第2次奉直戦後には国民軍総司令となって北京をおさえた
清朝の廃帝を紫禁城から追放して辛亥革命にひとつの結末をつけたのである

heading.en: The Kuomintang, the Northern Expedition and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1926年，馮玉祥加入國民黨並出任西北國民軍總司令；1928年他呼應北伐驅逐奉天軍，成為國民黨中央執行委員。1930年他發動反蔣運動失敗，被開除黨籍。抗日戰爭期間他重新入黨，1946年赴美發表反蔣聲明，1948年9月在蘇聯船上遇火災身亡。
body.en: In 1926 Feng joined the Kuomintang and became commander-in-chief of the Northwest National Army; in 1928 he responded to the Northern Expedition by driving out the Fengtian army and became a Kuomintang Central Executive Committee member. His 1930 anti-Chiang movement failed and he was expelled. He rejoined the party during the war against Japan, issued an anti-Chiang statement in the United States in 1946, and died in a fire aboard a Soviet ship in September 1948.

citations.quote: 1926年、国民党に入って西北国民軍総司令となった
1928年北伐に呼応して奉天軍を追い、国民党中央執行委員となったが
1930年には反蒋介石(しょうかいせき)運動を展開し失敗して除名された
抗日戦争中は復党し
1946年外遊してアメリカで反蒋声明を発表
48年9月，ソ連船中で火災にあい焼死した

heading.en: Northwest Frontier Defence and the Wuyuan oath-taking

body.zh-Hant: 1925年1月4日，馮玉祥接受段祺瑞執政府任命的西北邊防督辦一職，前往張家口整訓部隊。1926年9月他在五原誓師參加北伐，就任國民聯軍總司令；1927年5月1日，他在西安就任國民革命軍第二集團軍總司令，6日進駐潼關，準備東進河南。
body.en: On 4 January 1925 Feng accepted the post of Northwest Frontier Defence Commissioner from Duan Qirui's provisional government and went to Zhangjiakou to train his troops. In September 1926 he held the oath-taking at Wuyuan to join the Northern Expedition and took the post of commander-in-chief of the National Allied Army. On 1 May 1927 he took office at Xi'an as commander-in-chief of the Second Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army, and on 6 May he moved into Tongguan to prepare an advance into Henan.

heading.en: The Lanfeng campaign of 1927

body.zh-Hant: 1927年蘭封會戰中，10月中旬馮玉祥部在馬牧集與張宗昌、褚玉璞指揮的直魯聯軍作戰失利，馮決定集中主力於開封附近待機。10月26日起雙方在黃河南岸至杞縣一線激戰，30日拂曉韓復榘、石友三兩軍突然自背後猛攻，11月1日孫良誠軍佔領蘭封，直魯聯軍全線潰退。
body.en: In mid-October 1927 Feng's troops lost an engagement at Mamuji to the Zhili-Shandong army commanded by Zhang Zongchang and Chu Yupu, and Feng decided to hold his main force near Kaifeng and wait. From 26 October the two sides fought along the south bank of the Yellow River to Qixian; at dawn on 30 October the armies of Han Fuqu and Shi Yousan struck the enemy rear, and on 1 November Sun Liangcheng's army occupied Lanfeng as the Zhili-Shandong army collapsed along the whole line.

heading.zh-Hant: 察哈爾民眾抗日同盟軍
heading.en: The Chahar People's Anti-Japanese Allied Army

body.zh-Hant: 1933年5月26日，馮玉祥在張家口宣布察哈爾民眾抗日同盟軍成立，就任總司令。同盟軍先後收復康保、寶昌、沽源，7月12日克復被日偽軍佔據72天的多倫。臺大學報載，8月6日他通電下野；人民網則寫8月9日宣布撤銷同盟軍總部，兩說日期不同。
body.en: On 26 May 1933 Feng announced the founding of the Chahar People's Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou and took the post of commander-in-chief. The army retook Kangbao, Baochang and Guyuan in turn, and on 12 July recaptured Duolun, which Japanese and puppet forces had held for 72 days. An article in the National Taiwan University journal says he telegraphed his resignation on 6 August, while People's Daily says he announced the dissolution of the army's headquarters on 9 August; the two dates differ.

heading.en: The Battle of Xinkou

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰初期，國軍為確保山西，於10月2日命第十四集團軍衛立煌部統率4個半師，連夜由石家莊向太原以北集中。至10日崞縣、原平相繼失守，此時衛立煌部大半已集中於忻口及其以西地區，與晉軍會合，防守忻口陣地；12日起，中日展開忻口會戰。
body.en: In the early stage of the war of resistance, to secure Shanxi the National Army ordered the Fourteenth Army Group under Wei Lihuang, commanding four and a half divisions, to concentrate overnight from Shijiazhuang to the area north of Taiyuan on 2 October. By the 10th Guoxian and Yuanping had fallen and most of Wei's force had gathered at Xinkou and to its west, joining Shanxi troops to hold the Xinkou position; the Battle of Xinkou between China and Japan began from the 12th.

heading.en: The Battle of the Zhongtiao Mountains

body.zh-Hant: 1941年初，日軍判斷盤據中條山的國軍中央嫡系衛立煌部為擾亂華北治安的核心，先擊破中條山左右兩翼。當時國軍由第一戰區司令長官衛立煌指揮，配置在中條山脈內。此役中方稱作晉南會戰或中條山戰役，自5月7日起至27日止；開戰後衛立煌電令各軍，以一部留置山內抵抗，主力轉向日軍背後攻擊。
body.en: In early 1941 the Japanese judged Wei Lihuang's central-army force entrenched in the Zhongtiao Mountains to be the core of disturbance in North China and first broke the flanks on either side of the range. The Chinese forces there were under First War Zone commander Wei Lihuang. The Chinese called the operation the Southern Shanxi Campaign or Zhongtiao Mountains Campaign; it lasted from 7 to 27 May, and Wei ordered some units to stay and resist inside the mountains while the main force attacked the Japanese rear.

heading.zh-Hant: 遠征軍與陸軍副總司令
heading.en: The Expeditionary Force and deputy command of the Army

body.zh-Hant: 1942年初，中國遠征軍第一路成立，以衛立煌為總司令，因他未到任而由杜聿明代理。1943年11月，陳誠因病呈請派員接替，蔣中正於8日手令以衛立煌代理遠征軍司令長官職務。後來遠征軍被裁併，司令長官衛立煌調任陸軍副總司令，他與麾下將士皆表不滿，衛因此不就職。
body.en: In early 1942 the First Route of the Chinese Expeditionary Force was formed with Wei Lihuang as commander-in-chief, but because he did not take up the post Du Yuming acted in his place. In November 1943 Chen Cheng, ill, asked for a replacement, and on the 8th Chiang Kai-shek ordered Wei to act as commander of the Expeditionary Force. When the force was later merged away and Wei was transferred to deputy commander of the Army, he and his men were dissatisfied, and he did not assume the post.

heading.en: Background and the relief of Nankou

body.zh-Hant: 衛立煌（1897—1960），又名輝珊，字俊如，安徽合肥人，1917年任孫中山大本營警衛團排長。1937年8月11日，蔣介石命令他率第14軍第10、第83、第85師支援南口抗戰，部隊在平西山地與日軍激戰；同年10月他升任第14集團軍總司令兼第二戰區前敵總指揮，在山西忻口抗擊日軍，忻口戰役歷時一個多月。
body.en: Wei Lihuang (1897–1960), also known as Huishan and styled Junru, came from Hefei in Anhui and in 1917 was a platoon leader in Sun Yat-sen's headquarters guard regiment. On 11 August 1937 Chiang Kai-shek ordered him to lead the 10th, 83rd and 85th Divisions of the 14th Corps to relieve the defence of Nankou, and his troops fought the Japanese in the hills west of Beiping. In October of that year he was promoted commander of the 14th Group Army and front-line commander of the Second War Zone, and resisted the Japanese at Xinkou in Shanxi; the Xinkou campaign lasted more than a month.

heading.zh-Hant: 河南省主席免職與遠征軍
heading.en: Dismissal as Henan chairman and the Y-Force

body.zh-Hant: 據其孫口述，1942年1月衛立煌因「親共」之嫌被免去河南省主席職務，調任軍事委員會西安辦公廳主任。1943年11月他代理遠征軍司令長官，16日飛昆明、21日赴楚雄就職，其後指揮遠征軍擊敗滇西和中緬邊境日軍。
body.en: According to his grandson's recollection, in January 1942 Wei Lihuang was removed as chairman of Henan Province on suspicion of being "pro-Communist" and transferred to head the Xi'an office of the Military Commission. In November 1943 he became acting commander of the Y-Force; he flew to Kunming on the 16th and took up the post at Chuxiong on the 21st, and went on to command the force that defeated the Japanese in western Yunnan and on the Sino-Burmese border.

16日，衛立煌飛昆明，21日，赴楚雄就職

heading.zh-Hant: 東北剿匪總司令與遼瀋戰役
heading.en: Northeast Bandit Suppression commander and the Liaoshen campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1948年衛立煌任東北剿匪總司令，並兼蔣介石東北行轅副主任（美國國務院文件所載）。同年10月遼瀋戰役決戰階段，中共人員奉命到瀋陽勸說他。其孫稱他因未積極執行蔣介石的「反攻」命令，後被撤職並軟禁於南京，1949年初獲釋出走香港。
body.en: In 1948 Wei Lihuang was commander-in-chief of the Northeast Bandit Suppression forces and deputy director of Chiang Kai-shek's Northeast Headquarters, as recorded in a U.S. State Department document. In October 1948, during the decisive phase of the Liaoshen campaign, a Communist agent was ordered to Shenyang to persuade him. His grandson says that because he did not actively carry out Chiang's order to counterattack he was later dismissed and put under house arrest in Nanjing, and that he was released in early 1949 and left for Hong Kong.

heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 葉劍英是中國的軍人、政治家，生於1897年、卒於1986年，出身廣東省梅縣的客家人。他1919年自雲南講武學堂畢業，1924年任黃埔軍官學校教官，1926年加入中國共產黨。
body.en: Ye Jianying was a Chinese soldier and politician, born in 1897 and died in 1986, a Hakka from Meixian in Guangdong. He graduated from the Yunnan Military Academy in 1919, served as an instructor at the Whampoa Military Academy in 1924, and joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1926.

citations.quote: 広東(カントン)省梅県の客家(ハッカ)の出身
1919年雲南の講武学堂卒業、1924年黄埔(こうほ)軍官学校教官、1926年中国共産党入党

heading.en: The Guangzhou Commune, Jiangxi and the Long March

body.zh-Hant: 1927年葉劍英參加廣東公社（廣州公社）而失敗，後赴莫斯科中山大學留學，1931年回國。他進入江西蘇維埃區，歷任紅軍第三軍團參謀長、紅軍學校校長，其後任第一方面軍參謀長，並參加長征轉進陝北。西安事變之後，他出任紅軍西安辦事處主任。
body.en: In 1927 Ye took part in the failed Guangdong (Guangzhou) Commune, then studied at Sun Yat-sen University in Moscow and returned in 1931. Entering the Jiangxi Soviet area, he served as chief of staff of the Third Army Corps and head of the Red Army school, then as chief of staff of the First Front Army, and joined the Long March to northern Shaanxi. After the Xi'an Incident he became head of the Red Army's Xi'an liaison office.

heading.en: The war of resistance and after 1949

body.zh-Hant: 中日戰爭時，葉劍英任八路軍參謀長，1945年成為黨中央委員。1949年北京解放時任市長，後任華南軍區司令兼廣州市長，1955年獲元帥軍銜。1971年林彪失勢後，他代理國防部長，1975年正式任國防部長、黨副主席；1976年協助華國鋒政權誕生，1978年任全國人民代表大會常務委員長，1985年辭去一切職務。
body.en: During the Sino-Japanese War Ye was chief of staff of the Eighth Route Army, and in 1945 became a Party Central Committee member. With the liberation of Beijing in 1949 he became mayor, later commander of the South China Military Region and mayor of Guangzhou, and he was made marshal in 1955. After Lin Biao's fall in 1971 he acted as defence minister, and in 1975 became defence minister and Party vice-chairman; in 1976 he helped the Hua Guofeng government come to power, in 1978 he became chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, and in 1985 he retired from all posts.

heading.en: The Long March and Red Army chief of staff posts

body.zh-Hant: 1934年10月10日中央紅軍開始長征，葉劍英任軍委第一縱隊司令員兼政治委員，12月18日兩縱隊合併後任軍委縱隊副司令員兼第一局局長。1935年2月28日他赴紅三軍團任參謀長，協助彭德懷、楊尚昆指揮三渡赤水；7月21日改任紅軍前敵總指揮部參謀長。8月29日至31日，他與徐向前、陳昌浩指揮包座戰斗，殲敵1個師約5000人；11月又協助毛澤東、彭德懷指揮直羅鎮戰役。
body.en: When the Central Red Army began the Long March on 10 October 1934, Ye Jianying became commander and political commissar of the First Column of the Military Commission; on 18 December, after the columns merged, he became deputy commander of the Military Commission Column and head of its First Bureau. On 28 February 1935 he went to the Third Army Corps as chief of staff and helped Peng Dehuai and Yang Shangkun direct the third crossing of the Chishui; on 21 July he became chief of staff of the Red Army's Front Command. From 29 to 31 August he and Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao directed the Baozuo fighting, destroying a division of about 5,000 men, and in November he helped Mao Zedong and Peng Dehuai direct the Zhiluozhen campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 抗戰時期與北平和平接管
heading.en: The war years and the peaceful takeover of Beiping

body.zh-Hant: 1937年8月25日，葉劍英就任國民革命軍第八路軍參謀長；1941年2月14日任中央軍委參謀長兼十八集團軍參謀長。1946年1月13日他任軍事調處執行部中共代表。1948年12月13日起任北平市軍事管制委員會主任兼市長，1949年1月31日北平和平解放，8月19日改由聶榮臻繼任。
body.en: On 25 August 1937 Ye Jianying took office as chief of staff of the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army; on 14 February 1941 he became chief of staff of the Central Military Commission and of the Eighteenth Group Army. On 13 January 1946 he became the Communist representative on the Executive Headquarters for military mediation. From 13 December 1948 he was director of the Beiping Military Control Commission and mayor of Beiping; Beiping was peacefully liberated on 31 January 1949, and on 19 August Nie Rongzhen was appointed to succeed him.

heading.zh-Hant: 廣東戰役與海南島戰役
heading.en: The Guangdong and Hainan campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1949年8月1日，葉劍英被任命為中共中央華南分局第一書記；9月7日他主持作戰會議，制訂廣東戰役作戰方案。10月2日廣東戰役發起，11月4日結束，11月17日廣東省軍區成立，他任司令員兼政治委員。1950年2月他在廣州主持會議研究渡海作戰問題，4月16日渡海登陸戰役發起，5月1日海南島戰役結束。
body.en: On 1 August 1949 Ye Jianying was appointed first secretary of the South China Sub-bureau of the Party Central Committee; on 7 September he chaired the operations meeting that drew up the plan for the Guangdong campaign. The campaign began on 2 October and ended on 4 November, and on 17 November the Guangdong Military District was founded with him as commander and political commissar. In February 1950 he chaired a meeting in Guangzhou on the problem of an amphibious crossing, the landing campaign began on 16 April, and the Hainan Island campaign ended on 1 May.

heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 葉挺是中國的軍事指導者，生於1896年、卒於1946年，廣東省惠陽縣人，字希夷，為保定軍官學校第6期生。他1922年任孫文衛隊團營長，1924年留學當時的蘇聯，同年加入中國共產黨。
body.en: Ye Ting was a Chinese military leader, born in 1896 and died in 1946, from Huiyang County in Guangdong, with the courtesy name Xiyi, and a member of the sixth class of the Baoding Military Academy. In 1922 he became a battalion commander in Sun Yat-sen's guard regiment, and in 1924 he studied in the Soviet Union and joined the Chinese Communist Party the same year.

citations.quote: 広東(カントン)省恵陽県の人。字(あざな)は希夷(きい)。保定軍官学校6期生で
1922年孫文(そんぶん)衛隊団の営長となる
1924年、当時のソ連に留学、同年中国共産党に入党した

heading.zh-Hant: 北伐、南昌暴動與廣州公社
heading.en: The Northern Expedition, the Nanchang Uprising and the Guangzhou Commune

body.zh-Hant: 1925年葉挺回國，北伐時任第四軍獨立團團長，在最前線作戰，部隊號稱鐵軍。1927年蔣介石發動上海政變後，他率第11軍第24師參加南昌暴動，南下後參加廣州公社；公社崩潰後，他經香港前往德國。世界大百科事典則寫他1926年以國民革命軍第4軍連隊長身分參加北伐，後升任第24師長。
body.en: Ye returned to China in 1925 and, during the Northern Expedition, served as commander of the independent regiment of the Fourth Army, fighting at the front and earning the name of the Iron Army. After Chiang Kai-shek's 1927 Shanghai coup he took part in the Nanchang Uprising leading the 24th Division of the 11th Army, went south to join the Guangzhou Commune, and after its collapse left for Germany via Hong Kong. The Sekai Daihyakka Jiten adds that he joined the 1926 Northern Expedition as a regimental commander of the National Revolutionary Army's Fourth Army and was promoted to commander of its 24th Division.

citations.quote: 翌1925年帰国し、北伐時は第四軍独立団団長として最前線にたち、武勇をはせ、鉄軍とよばれた

南下して広州コミューンに参加、コミューン崩壊後、香港(ホンコン)を経てドイツへ出国した

heading.en: The New Fourth Army and the Southern Anhui Incident

body.zh-Hant: 1938年1月新四軍成立時，葉挺出任軍長；世界大百科事典稱這是國共妥協人事。他在抗日戰爭中擴大華中根據地，但1941年在皖南事件中被國民黨軍俘虜。1946年獲釋後，他在前往延安途中，於4月8日因飛機事故身亡。
body.en: When the New Fourth Army was formed in January 1938, Ye became its commander; the Sekai Daihyakka Jiten calls the appointment a Kuomintang–Communist compromise. He expanded the central China base area during the war against Japan but was captured by Kuomintang forces in the 1941 Southern Anhui Incident. Released in 1946, he died in an aircraft accident on 8 April while travelling to Yan'an.

heading.en: The Independent Regiment and the Northern Expedition

body.zh-Hant: 1925年9月葉挺回國，任第四軍參謀處長，後改任獨立團團長。1926年5月20日獨立團受命出師北伐，6月3日在湖南安仁迎擊敵軍六個團，擊破謝文炳整師；8月底北伐軍發起汀泗橋、賀勝橋戰役，獨立團在兩役中發揮關鍵作用，所在第四軍因此得「鐵軍」之稱；9月3日北伐軍進攻武昌城，10月10日占領。
body.en: Ye Ting returned to China in September 1925 and became chief of the staff office of the Fourth Army, later commanding the Independent Regiment. The regiment was ordered out on the Northern Expedition on 20 May 1926; on 3 June it met six enemy regiments at Anren in Hunan and broke Xie Wenbing's entire division. At the end of August the expeditionary army launched the Dingsiqiao and Heshengqiao campaigns, in which the regiment played a key part and the Fourth Army earned the name "Ironsides"; the assault on Wuchang began on 3 September and the city was taken on 10 October.

citations.quote: １９２５年９月回國后，經國共雙方協商，葉挺任國民革命軍第四軍參謀處長，后改任獨立團團長

以一团之兵力击破敌军谢文炳整师

尤其是在汀泗桥、贺胜桥这两个北伐最有名的战役中发挥了关键性作用，为所在的第四军赢得了“铁军”称号
同年9月3日，北伐军进攻武昌城。10月10日，北伐军占领武昌城

heading.zh-Hant: 南昌起義、廣州起義與流亡
heading.en: The Nanchang and Guangzhou uprisings and exile

body.zh-Hant: 1927年8月1日南昌起義，葉挺任前敵總指揮；同年12月，廣東省委又以他為軍事總指揮發動廣州起義。起義失敗後，廣東省委於1928年1月對他處以留黨察看六個月，他其後流亡德國十年。
body.en: In the Nanchang Uprising of 1 August 1927 Ye Ting served as front-line commander-in-chief; in December of that year the Guangdong Party committee made him military commander-in-chief of the Guangzhou Uprising. After it failed, the committee in January 1928 placed him on six months' probation within the Party, and he then lived in exile in Germany for ten years.

citations.quote: １９２７年８月１日，中國共產黨發動南昌起義，葉挺任前敵總指揮
同年１２月，根據黨中央指示，中共廣東省委又以葉挺為軍事總指揮發動廣州起義
作出對葉挺予以留黨察看六個月的處分
葉挺流亡德國１０年，從此脫黨

heading.zh-Hant: 新四軍軍長與皖南事變
heading.en: Commander of the New Fourth Army and the Southern Anhui Incident

body.zh-Hant: 1937年9月28日，國民政府軍事委員會任命葉挺為新四軍軍長（另有說法為10月12日轉發蔣介石6日電令）。1941年1月4日他與項英率軍部等9000餘人自雲嶺出發，7日在茂林遭七個師包圍，經七晝夜血戰主力犧牲，他赴敵108師師部談判時被扣押；1月17日軍事委員會宣布取消新四軍番號並將他革職。1946年3月4日他獲釋。
body.en: On 28 September 1937 the Military Commission of the National Government appointed Ye Ting commander of the New Fourth Army (another account puts it at 12 October, when Chiang Kai-shek's order of the 6th was forwarded). On 4 January 1941 he and Xiang Ying led the army's headquarters and over 9,000 men out of Yunling; on the 7th they were surrounded at Maolin by seven divisions, and after seven days of bloody fighting most were killed. Ye was detained when he went to the 108th Division's headquarters to negotiate. On 17 January the Military Commission announced that the army's designation was cancelled and Ye dismissed. He was released on 4 March 1946.
